brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: A single hex base, with nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: The build is one piece: a Hex base · Full at 0,0,0 with no other parts, props or soil. check_build reports meshClash clear and only an info note about open cap faces.

Drawers attach only to the cut face of a half base. The full base has no cut face, so find_sockets offers no drawer position on it. Swapping in a half base was refused (replace only applies to bins, notches, bays or accessories), and adding half bases would break R1. No drawers were placed.

finish.summary: The build is a single Hex base · Full with nothing else added, which meets the single-base requirement. It holds no drawers: drawers only fit on the cut face of a half base, and a full base offers no such face. To get five drawers the base would have to be a half base with additional half bases, which conflicts with the single-base requirement, so I left the requirement unmet rather than break the single-base one.
